items.title: Pay income tax back payment (Nachzahlung)
items.computation: The letter states the due date explicitly as 05.02.2026. This is a Thursday and not a Bavarian public holiday, so no adjustment under §108 Abs.3 AO / §193 BGB is needed. Due date stands as printed.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Step 1 – Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery): the notice states it was 'am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben' and is deemed delivered on the fourth day after posting (current §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO, extended from 3 to 4 days). 02.01.2026 (Fri) + 4 days = 06.01.2026 (Tue). However, 06.01. (Epiphany/Heilige Drei Könige) is a public holiday in Bavaria, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the fictitious delivery date shifts to the next business day: 07.01.2026 (Wed). Step 2 – Start of the one-month period: under §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (07.01.2026) is not counted; the period starts running on 08.01.2026. Step 3 – End of the one-month period: under §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §188 Abs.2 BGB, a period of one month ends with the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 07.02.2026. Step 4 – 07.02.2026 falls on a Saturday, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 09.02.2026 (no intervening Bavarian holiday). Final Einspruch deadline: 09.02.2026.
